literal: Xingzong, Part One
idiomatic: Xingzong, Part One

literal: In the eleventh year, summer, sixth month, on jimao day, Shengzong died; immediately took the imperial throne before the coffin.
idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on jimao day of the sixth summer month Shengzong died, and [the heir] immediately took the throne before the coffin.

literal: On rennwu day, honored mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On rennwu day the new Emperor honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager.

literal: On jiashen day, dispatched envoys to announce the mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo.
idiomatic: On jiashen day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo.

literal: That year, held jinshi examination at Xuanzheng Hall and released fifty-seven including Liu Zhen.
idiomatic: That year jinshi examinations were held at Xuanzheng Hall and fifty-seven candidates including Liu Zhen passed.

literal: On xinmao day, general amnesty; changed era name to Jingfu.
idiomatic: On xinmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Jingfu.

literal: On yiwei day, escorted the late Emperor's coffin and encoffined it at Taiping Hall on Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: On yiwei day the late Emperor's coffin was escorted and encoffined at Taiping Hall on Yong'an Mountain.

literal: On xinchou day, the Empress Dowager ordered imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu to death and Xiao Pide to death; Hunt-grounds grand preceptor Jurchen Zhuguli, Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen Xiao Yanliu, and seven others were all executed in the marketplace; their households were confiscated; Empress Qi Tian was moved to the Upper Capital.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the Empress Dowager ordered imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu and Xiao Pide to death; Hunt-grounds grand preceptor Jurchen Zhuguli, Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen Xiao Yanliu, and seven others were all executed in the marketplace; their households were confiscated; and Empress Qi Tian was moved to the Upper Capital.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the bingwu new moon, the Empress Dowager led the imperial clan in great mourning at Taiping Hall.
idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the seventh autumn month the Empress Dowager led the imperial clan in great mourning at Taiping Hall.

literal: Goryeo dispatched envoys to express condolences.
idiomatic: Goryeo dispatched envoys to express condolences.

literal: The Emperor summoned Prince of Jin Xiao Pugu and others to drink and gamble; only at midnight did they stop.
idiomatic: The Emperor summoned Prince of Jin Xiao Pugu and others to drink and gamble; only at midnight did they stop.

literal: On dingwei day, played cuju.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the court played cuju.

literal: On wushen day, made Yelü Hanba Left yilibi, Temuli Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen, and Cross-Tent langjun Yegu acting Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen.
idiomatic: On wushen day Yelü Hanba was appointed Left yilibi; Temuli was made Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen; and Cross-Tent langjun Yegu acting Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen.

literal: On jiyou day, made Yelü Zhengliu Ugu diledu xiangwen and Gao Ba Right Pishi xiangwen.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Yelü Zhengliu was appointed Ugu diledu xiangwen and Gao Ba Right Pishi xiangwen.

literal: On gengxu day, provided relief for hungry people in Jizhou.
idiomatic: On gengxu day relief was provided for hungry people in Jizhou.

literal: On guichou day, edict ordered painting of the late Emperor's portrait.
idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ordered the late Emperor's portrait painted.

literal: On jiayin day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Made observation commissioner Yao Juxin upper general.
idiomatic: Observation commissioner Yao Juxin was appointed upper general.

literal: Built Qingzhou south of Qing Mausoleum, moved people to fill it, serving as mausoleum-attendant settlement.
idiomatic: Qingzhou was built south of Qing Mausoleum; people were moved to fill it, serving as a mausoleum-attendant settlement.

literal: On yimao day, because grain harvest had been abundant in recent years, ceased supplying grain to the Eastern Capital military governor's office.
idiomatic: On yimao day, because grain harvests had been abundant in recent years, grain supplies to the Eastern Capital military governor's office were discontinued.

literal: On dingsi day, the Emperor visited the late Emperor's portrait and mourned deeply for a long time.
idiomatic: On dingsi day the Emperor visited the late Emperor's portrait and mourned deeply for a long time.

literal: Thereupon edict ordered painting portraits of Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaoxian and Southern Chancellor Xiao Xiaomu in the Imperial Portrait Hall.
idiomatic: Thereupon an edict ordered portraits of Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaoxian and Southern Chancellor Xiao Xiaomu painted in the Imperial Portrait Hall.

literal: Made Xiao Aguzhen Eastern Capital regent.
idiomatic: Xiao Aguzhen was appointed Eastern Capital regent.

literal: On dingmao day, visited Taiping Hall and burned the late Emperor's bow and arrows.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the court visited Taiping Hall and burned the late Emperor's bow and arrows.

literal: Visited Prince of Jin Pugu's residence to inquire after his illness.
idiomatic: The court visited Prince of Jin Pugu's residence to inquire after his illness.

literal: On xinwei day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On xinwei day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On renshen day, the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and he was also ordered to bow to her.
idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and he was also ordered to bow to her.

literal: In the eighth month, on renwu day, moved the late Emperor's coffin to Zutu Hall.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renwu day, the late Emperor's coffin was moved to Zutu Hall.

literal: In the ninth month, on wushen day, personally inspected Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen day, the Emperor personally inspected Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On gengxu day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: On xinhai day, Song sent Wang Sui and Cao Yi to perform sacrifices; Wang Ji, Xu Huaixin, Mei Xun, and Zhang Lun came to console the two palaces; Fan Feng and Sun Jiye congratulated on the accession; Kong Daofu and Wei Zhaowen congratulated on the Empress Dowager's post-mourning investiture rites.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Song sent Wang Sui and Cao Yi to perform sacrifices; Wang Ji, Xu Huaixin, Mei Xun, and Zhang Lun came to console the two palaces; Fan Feng and Sun Jiye congratulated on the accession; and Kong Daofu and Wei Zhaowen congratulated on the Empress Dowager's post-mourning investiture rites.

literal: On wuwu day, burned bows, arrows, saddle, and bridle at Zutu Hall.
idiomatic: On wuwu day bows, arrows, saddle, and bridle were burned at Zutu Hall.

literal: On gengshen day, Xia State sent envoys with condolences.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Xia State sent envoys with condolences.

literal: On gengwu day, because Song envoys came to mourn and sacrifice, wore mourning dress and attended at Zutu Hall.
idiomatic: On gengwu day, because Song envoys came to mourn and sacrifice, the Emperor wore mourning dress and attended at Zutu Hall.

literal: On jiaxu day, dispatched Censorate Vice Director Yelü Xu, Minister of Agriculture Zhang Que, xiangwen Yelü Li, and Four Directions Bureau envoy Gao Weihan to thank Song for condolences.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Censorate Vice Director Yelü Xu, Minister of Agriculture Zhang Que, xiangwen Yelü Li, and Four Directions Bureau envoy Gao Weihan were dispatched to thank Song for condolences.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on wuyin day, chief minister Lü Demao died.
idiomatic: On wuyin day of the tenth winter month chief minister Lü Demao died.

literal: On guiwei day, killed Cubu faction members Mile Nu, Guanyin Nu, and others.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Cubu faction members Mile Nu, Guanyin Nu, and others were executed.

literal: On bingxu day, dispatched Minister of Works Gao Deshun and Chamberlain for Imperial Insignia Li Kefeng to present the late Emperor's bequests to Song;
idiomatic: On bingxu day Minister of Works Gao Deshun and Chamberlain for Imperial Insignia Li Kefeng were dispatched to present the late Emperor's bequests to Song;

literal: made Right Imperial Guard upper general Yelü Xun and Palace Manufactories supervisor Ma Dan envoys to thank Song on behalf of the Empress Dowager;
idiomatic: Right Imperial Guard upper general Yelü Xun and Palace Manufactories supervisor Ma Dan were appointed envoys to thank Song on behalf of the Empress Dowager;

literal: Right Palace Gate Guard upper general Yelü Yuanzai and presenting envoy Wei Yong served as the Emperor's envoys to thank Song.
idiomatic: Right Palace Gate Guard upper general Yelü Yuanzai and presenting envoy Wei Yong served as the Emperor's envoys to thank Song.

literal: On dingyou day, Xia State sent envoys with funeral gifts.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Xia State sent envoys with funeral gifts.

literal: On wuxu day, appointed Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: In the intercalary month, on xinhai day, visited Zutu Hall and inspected inner-chamber vessels.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinhai day, the court visited Zutu Hall and inspected inner-chamber vessels.

literal: The relevant offices requested making the birthday the Eternal Longevity Festival and the Empress Dowager's birthday the Responding Sage Festival; approved.
idiomatic: The relevant offices requested making the Emperor's birthday the Eternal Longevity Festival and the Empress Dowager's birthday the Responding Sage Festival; approval was granted.

literal: On xinyou day, inspected newly made armor.
idiomatic: On xinyou day newly made armor was inspected.

literal: On dingmao day, relieved hungry people in Huanglong Prefecture.
idiomatic: On dingmao day hungry people in Huanglong Prefecture were relieved.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen day, the Emperor led all officials in offerings at Zutu Hall.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the eleventh month the Emperor led all officials in offerings at Zutu Hall.

literal: Brought out the late Emperor's clothing, accoutrements, and treasured articles and burned them.
idiomatic: The late Emperor's clothing, accoutrements, and treasured articles were brought out and burned.

literal: Released the five-compound hawks and falcons.
idiomatic: The five-compound hawks and falcons were released.

literal: On jiawu day, buried the Cultured and Martial Great Filial Xuan Emperor at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the Cultured and Martial Great Filial Xuan Emperor was buried at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On yiwei day, sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On yiwei day sacrifices were offered to Heaven and Earth.

literal: Paid respects to the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: The Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager.

literal: On bingshen day, visited Qing Mausoleum, bestowed bequest articles on ministers, named the mountain Qingyun, and the hall Wangxian.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the court visited Qing Mausoleum, bestowed bequest articles on ministers, named the mountain Qingyun, and named the hall Wangxian.

literal: In the twelfth month, on guichou day, returned from Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the twelfth month the court returned from Qing Mausoleum.

literal: The Empress Dowager held court; the Emperor did not personally handle routine affairs; ministers memorialized requesting [him to], but he did not agree.
idiomatic: The Empress Dowager held court; the Emperor did not personally handle routine affairs; ministers memorialized requesting that he do so, but he did not agree.

literal: That year, Princess Xingping was married to Li Dezhao's son Yuanhao of Xia State; Yuanhao was made Duke of Xia State and Commandant of Imperial Son-in-law.
idiomatic: That year Princess Xingping was married to Li Dezhao's son Yuanhao of Xia State; Yuanhao was made Duke of Xia State and Commandant of Imperial Son-in-law.

literal: In the first year of Chongqing, spring, first month, on the renshen new moon, the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
idiomatic: In the first year of Chongqing, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.

literal: Song sent Ren Bu, Wang Zunfan, Chen Yan, and Wang Keshan to congratulate.
idiomatic: Song sent Ren Bu, Wang Zunfan, Chen Yan, and Wang Keshan with congratulations.

literal: On yihai day, Song sent Zheng Xiang and Guo Zunfan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
idiomatic: On yihai day Song sent Zheng Xiang and Guo Zunfan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

literal: On dingchou day, went to Xuelin.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the court went to Xuelin.

literal: In the second month, held a grand hunt.
idiomatic: In the second month a grand hunt was held.

literal: On the renshen new moon of the third month, Imperial Father, Prince of Qishui Dilie, was again appointed tiyin.
idiomatic: On the renshen new moon of the third month Imperial Father, Prince of Qishui Dilie, was again appointed tiyin.

literal: That spring, the Empress Dowager falsely charged Empress Qi Tian with crimes and dispatched people to assassinate her at the Upper Capital.
idiomatic: That spring the Empress Dowager falsely charged Empress Qi Tian with crimes and dispatched people to assassinate her at the Upper Capital.

literal: The Empress requested a full bath before death; permission was granted.
idiomatic: The Empress requested a full bath before death; permission was granted.

literal: Before long the Empress died.
idiomatic: Before long the Empress died.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on yisi day, took summer retreat at Bielian Dou.
idiomatic: On yisi day of the fourth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Bielian Dou.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

literal: Appointed Xiao Dapu, Wang Yingxiu, Xiao Lu, and Zhang Suyu envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day and birthdays of the coming year.
idiomatic: Xiao Dapu, Wang Yingxiu, Xiao Lu, and Zhang Suyu were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day and birthdays of the coming year.

literal: In the eighth month, on bingwu day, encamped at Cila River source.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingwu day, the court encamped at Cila River source.

literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
idiomatic: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on jiyou day, visited the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital.

literal: In the eleventh month, on jimao day, the Emperor led ministers in presenting to the Empress Dowager the honorific title Responding to Heaven, Following the Mandate, Benevolent and Virtuous, Manifest Sage Empress Dowager;
idiomatic: On jimao day of the eleventh month the Emperor led ministers in presenting to the Empress Dowager the honorific title Responding to Heaven, Following the Mandate, Benevolent and Virtuous, Manifest Sage Empress Dowager;

literal: ministers presented to the Emperor the honorific title Cultured and Martial, Benevolent and Sage, Illustrious and Filial Emperor.
idiomatic: ministers presented to the Emperor the honorific title Cultured and Martial, Benevolent and Sage, Illustrious and Filial Emperor.

literal: General amnesty; changed era name to Chongqing.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Chongqing.

literal: On guiwei day, Song sent Liu Sui and Wang Deben to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Song sent Liu Sui and Wang Deben to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.

literal: Made Yang Jie Hanlin Academician Recipient.
idiomatic: Yang Jie was appointed Hanlin Academician Recipient.

literal: On bingxu day, Xia State sent envoys to congratulate.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Xia State sent envoys to congratulate.

literal: On xinmao day, chiefs of the Five States came with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinmao day chiefs of the Five States came with tribute.

literal: King Li Dezhao of Xia State died; his son Duke of Xia State Yuanhao was enfeoffed as King of Xia State.
idiomatic: King Li Dezhao of Xia State died; his son Duke of Xia State Yuanhao was enfeoffed as King of Xia State.

literal: In the twelfth month, on gengxu day, Song sent Xu Yan, Wang Congyi, Cui Ji, and Zhang Huaizhi to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year;
idiomatic: On gengxu day of the twelfth month Song sent Xu Yan, Wang Congyi, Cui Ji, and Zhang Huaizhi to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year;

literal: also sent Yang Riyan and Wang Kezuan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
idiomatic: Song also sent Yang Riyan and Wang Kezuan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

literal: Made Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhantong Associate Councilor of State.
idiomatic: Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhantong was appointed Associate Councilor of State.

literal: That year, released jinshi Liu Shizhen and fifty-six others.
idiomatic: That year jinshi examinations were held and Liu Shizhen and fifty-six others passed.

literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on gengchen day, made an eastern tour.
idiomatic: In the second year, on gengchen day of the first spring month the court made an eastern tour.

literal: On yiyou day, Xia State sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On renchen day, Jurchen xiangwen Taiyashuai came with his followers to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On renchen day Jurchen xiangwen Taiyashuai came with his followers to pay tribute.

literal: Song sent Cao Cong to announce mourning for Empress Dowager Liu, and Zhang Dexiang and An Jichang came bearing her bequests.
idiomatic: Song sent Cao Cong to announce mourning for Empress Dowager Liu, and Zhang Dexiang and An Jichang came bearing her bequests.

literal: Immediately dispatched Xingsheng Palace envoy Yelü Shouning and Supervising Censor drafting edicts Li Kui as sacrificial envoys;
idiomatic: Xingsheng Palace envoy Yelü Shouning and Supervising Censor drafting edicts Li Kui were immediately dispatched as sacrificial envoys;

literal: Tiande Army military commissioner Yelü Qingning, Court of Judicial Review director He Daoheng, Hexi Army military commissioner Yelü Song, and presenting envoy Ma Shiqing served as envoys to console the two palaces.
idiomatic: Tiande Army military commissioner Yelü Qingning, Court of Judicial Review director He Daoheng, Hexi Army military commissioner Yelü Song, and presenting envoy Ma Shiqing served as envoys to console the two palaces.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the jiazi new moon, appointed Yelü Shi, Gao Sheng, Yelü Di, and Wang Weiyun chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the two Song palaces on birthdays, and Yelü Shigu and Liu Wuchang chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of the seventh autumn month Yelü Shi, Gao Sheng, Yelü Di, and Wang Weiyun were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the two Song palaces on birthdays, and Yelü Shigu and Liu Wuchang chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, visited Hot Springs Palace.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou day, the court visited Hot Springs Palace.

literal: On yimao day, dispatched envoys to inspect grain crops on all routes.
idiomatic: On yimao day envoys were dispatched to inspect grain crops on all routes.

literal: In winter, eleventh month, on jiashen day, Song sent Liu Bao, Fu Zhong, Li Zhaoshu, Zhang Maoshi, and others to thank for consolation and offerings.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the eleventh winter month Song sent Liu Bao, Fu Zhong, Li Zhaoshu, Zhang Maoshi, and others to thank for consolation and offerings.

literal: In the twelfth month, on yiwei day, Song sent Ding Du and Wang Jining to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
idiomatic: On yiwei day of the twelfth month Song sent Ding Du and Wang Jining to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.

literal: On yiyou day, forbade Xia State envoys from privately trading gold and iron along the route.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Xia State envoys were forbidden to privately trade gold and iron along the route.

literal: On jiayin day, Song sent Zhang Pin, Li Yi, Wang Chongmu, Zhang Wei, Li Hong, and Li Jiyi to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Song sent Zhang Pin, Li Yi, Wang Chongmu, Zhang Wei, Li Hong, and Li Jiyi to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: On gengshen day, made Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaoxian Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaoxian was appointed Privy Commissioner.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on dingmao day, Song envoy Zhang Pin died; edict ordered the relevant offices to grant funeral gifts and commanded close attendants to escort the coffin home.
idiomatic: In the third year, on dingmao day of the first spring month Song envoy Zhang Pin died; an edict ordered the relevant offices to grant funeral gifts and commanded close attendants to escort the coffin home.

literal: On xinmao day, went to spring waters.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court went to spring waters.

literal: On the renchen new moon of the second month, made Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Pugu Eastern Capital regent.
idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the second month Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Pugu was appointed Eastern Capital regent.
